status: Unlinked source-only implementation preparation; not level 10 acceptance

privateProbe.status: Private source-data adapter probe only; not gameplay/native acceptance

scope.sourcePaths: Injected privately; no original path samples in repository

clocks.dispatch: One callback per observed changed client count, no catch-up; snapshot at dynamic activation. Caller owns persistent clocks and SU traversal.

contracts.sourceOrder: Per-sprite observe methods; synchronous effect adapter; diagnostic returned events must not be redispatched. Original source outline at pre-commit descriptorFrame drives explosion collision.
contracts.spark: Strict fresh TickCount > latchedTick + adjustPeriod(60), then frames 4..8, travelling starts at 8 without path advance until next callback. Serialized next BO index and exit token choose next route direction.
contracts.goodie: Sound, flourish at RO offset(+18,+18), floating score at x+10/y+16, collected latch, +10 time, +1000 actor bonus. Still visible until flourish completion; first visible collision can be already collected and block later overlaps.
contracts.match: Any armed human match; ordinary nonhuman requires any nonzero flags. Synchronous spark allocation then hide all same-grid LI then sound 11 then disarm, even on SR exhaustion.
contracts.actorBomb: Source-slot order, visible/original-outline collision; hide and set Child deadline +300 ticks; human slots 0/1 invoke reason -1. Ordinary types 1-3 never auto-resurrect.
contracts.dotBomb: Human permission +0x11 required; ring prevents adding burnt look; clear bonus when applicable; preserve pivot/goal/colors/grab permission. Source +0x12 is optimized background state, separate from sourceCollidable. Repaint optimized background even unchanged. Changed live sprite look resets current frame and main/secondary min/max, not clock/permissions.

specialDotSourceReview.availablePureRing: Runtime ring look 0x200 prevents adding burnt 0x40. Range remains 23+7*color through +7; unavailable ring is skipped. Bonus removal can reset range/current frame through DOUpdateLook. Human release still uses ring bit and current range.
specialDotSourceReview.checkpoint: Look 0x100 wins ahead of burnt and retains 79..89. First hit can still set burnt metadata and call DOUpdateLook, resetting current frame to 79 without automatically changing angular step/clock.
specialDotSourceReview.protection: Raw 0x40 maps to DOSpec+0xb / DOInfo+0x1f and separate misc type 2. It is not runtime look0x80, which is slowdown. Ordinary protected base can become burnt, keeping protection and separate overlay.
specialDotSourceReview.reset: DOReset first clears burnt bit and invokes DOUpdateLook, then restores saved bonus and invokes DOUpdateLook, resurrects rings, stops/detaches checkpoints, handles slowdown/moving/updown, clears selected checkpoint pointer. Burnt checkpoint resets to 79 via earlier look update; unburnt nonbonus checkpoint can retain phase. DORestartLevel explicitly sets selected checkpoint to 79.
specialDotSourceReview.implementationGate: New helper permits plain static/ring dots only, rejects protection/checkpoint/slowdown/transfer-death/moving/updown/connectors. No root ring/checkpoint/protection helper edits.

unsupported: Rotating spike/type4 and buster/type5 actor hooks
Moving pivots, moving/updown dots, connectors, teleport interactions
Door/switch/elevator/gun/trigger/oil integrations; stage callbacks remain present but caller must reject those active combinations
Exact live SU scheduler, native sound/timing/route equivalence
Background topology restoration, original colliders, scoreboard and live renderer integration
limitations: Original hidden terminal SRPosition performs one out-of-path sample after hiding; this implementation deliberately omits that unobservable private-memory read.
Constructor validates starter termination and terminal safe neighborhood, but geometry continuity, route/profile hashes and supported active catalog features are caller prerequisites.
All effects are synchronous adapters; no collision geometry, wall topology, sound playback, score persistence or actual sprite list is implemented here.
External DO/SP/WL/WA reset remains caller-owned; BombRuntime.reset only restores its BO/LI/SR/GO/explosion state.
Freeze at source barrier, after completing the current actor collision sequence; do not suppress later source side effects merely because a death latch was set.
Native and browser qualification, goal route, reset visuals and timing remain outstanding.
assetBoundary: Root reports accepted Some Dots V2 normal baseline has 55 payloads. Future Bombs QA must preserve every one and copy only the nine Bomb-owned additions; old candidate Some Dots V1 files must never replace accepted V2 assets. No asset mutation or conversion performed here.
